Name: STF - Krobus Shop Overhaul
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
[center][b][size=4]STF - Krobus Shop Overhaul[/size][/b]

It’s an overhaul of Krobus Shop!
This version still supports Shop Tile Framework, but it is considered deprecated due to new mechanics introduced in Stardew Valley 1.6. Future game updates may cause compatibility issues, and upcoming versions of this mod may no longer rely on STF.
This release includes multiple added items with individualized unlock conditions, alongside ongoing balance improvements and minor refinements that are still in development.
This version is intended as a foundation for a future transition to Content Patcher-based implementation of the shop system. Feedback, suggestions, and contributions are highly welcome.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][line]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10544/10544-1641433759-952050414.jpeg[/img][line]
[/center]
[center][size=4]I've added all the products related to Krobus, essential items he should have been selling all along!

Everything was added in a way that doesn't break the game's immersion and maintains a balanced economy.

Swipe through the products and see what you can buy now!

For more suggestions, feel free to use the comments section, and if you're comfortable, start a discussion.[/size][/center]
